n_input = int(input())
m_input = int(input())

MOD_CONST = 1000000007

class MatrixType:
    def __init__(self, dimension):
        self.dimension = dimension
        self.matrix = [[0] * dimension for _ in range(dimension)]
        
    def __mul__(self, other):
        C = MatrixType(self.dimension)
        for i in range(self.dimension):
            for j in range(self.dimension):
                total = 0
                for k in range(self.dimension):
                    total += self.matrix[i][k] * other.matrix[k][j]
                C.matrix[i][j] = total % MOD_CONST
        return C

# Initialize baseMatrix and identityMatrix
baseMatrix = MatrixType(m_input + 1)
identityMatrix = MatrixType(m_input + 1)

for i in range(m_input + 1):
    baseMatrix.matrix[i][i] = 1
    baseMatrix.matrix[0][i] = 1
    identityMatrix.matrix[i][i] = 1

# Calculate levelIdx
yVal = 1
yPow = 1
levelIdx = 0
while yPow * m_input <= n_input:
    yPow *= m_input
    levelIdx += 1

# Initialize biMatrices
biMatrices = [[MatrixType(m_input + 1) for _ in range(m_input + 1)] for _ in range(levelIdx + 1)]

for t in range(levelIdx + 1):
    if t > 0:
        biMatrices[t][0] = biMatrices[t - 1][0]
        for i in range(1, m_input + 1):
            biMatrices[t][0] = biMatrices[t][0] * biMatrices[t - 1][i]
    for i in range(1, m_input + 1):
        biMatrices[t][i] = biMatrices[t][i - 1]
        # Swap rows
        for j in range(m_input - 1):
            for k in range(m_input + 1):
                biMatrices[t][i].matrix[j][k], biMatrices[t][i].matrix[j + 1][k] = biMatrices[t][i].matrix[j + 1][k], biMatrices[t][i].matrix[j][k]
        # Swap columns
        for j in range(m_input - 1):
            for k in range(m_input + 1):
                biMatrices[t][i].matrix[k][j], biMatrices[t][i].matrix[k][j + 1] = biMatrices[t][i].matrix[k][j + 1], biMatrices[t][i].matrix[k][j]

current = identityMatrix
total = 0

while total < n_input:
    if total + yPow <= n_input:
        total += yPow
        current = current * biMatrices[levelIdx][0]
        yVal = (yVal + 1) % m_input
    else:
        yPow //= m_input
        levelIdx -= 1

answerSum = 0
for i in range(m_input + 1):
    answerSum = (answerSum + current.matrix[i][m_input]) % MOD_CONST

print(answerSum)
